operatorControls: The existing operator CLI can pause one exact open assignment and later remove that pause. Active ownership releases only after the existing task-journal and exact Wake-response checks. The original assignment stays open.
revocation: The waiting order skips a closed task or an exact execution-revoked marker. A missing or conflicting identity stops advancement. A revoked grant never releases an active owner by itself.
effects: A paused task retains read access through its existing authority. A resumed task reenters on its next authorized effect request. No project file or browser input is produced by the pause or resume operation.
